text: Rash is a key daraxonrasib toxicity despite recommended upfront tetracycline + topical steroid (adherence not specified). COCOON's bundle (ceramide barrier, 12 wks not 8, scalp care) cut grade ≥2 non-paronychia derm AEs 46%. Cross-trial comparisons are inherently flawed, and ami-laz isn’t purely pathway-driven. Dr. Shubham Pant, you’ve been discussing this; has a COCOON-style approach come up? #PancreaticCancer #MedicalOncology #SupportiveCare

With 2L daraxonrasib doubling mOS vs chemo for mPDAC in RASolute 302 (now under FDA review), focus is already shifting towards 1L (RASolute 303) and even adjuvant use (RASolute 304). In parallel, novel agents are advancing to personalize therapy for KRAS G12D and MTAP loss.

With benefit still measured in months and oncology teams pivoting to address toxicities, I'm looking forward to seeing where the research takes us!
